keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Ethan Mbappé (Lille).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lens. Junior Kadile replaces Florian Sotoca.
Substitution, Lens. Kyllian Antonio replaces Jean-Clair Todibo.
Substitution, Lens. Franjo Ivanovic replaces Thorgan Hazard.
Substitution, Lens. Yacine Titraoui replaces Michaël Cuisance.
Substitution, Lille. Olivier Giroud replaces Ethan Mbappé.
Substitution, Lille. Dilane Bakwa replaces Ngal'ayel Mukau.
Substitution, Lille. Calvin Verdonk replaces Romain Perraud.
Substitution, Lens. Andrija Bulatovic replaces Amadou Haidara.
Goal! Lille 1, Lens 0. Olivier Giroud (Lille) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Lille. Gaëtan Perrin replaces Hákon Haraldsson.
